adds.title: Guam Criminal Code reform of 1978
adds.summary: Guam's Criminal and Correctional Code enacted September 2, 1976 and effective January 1, 1978 limited sodomy and sex perversion liability to non-consenting acts, public acts, and acts with persons under 16, thereby decriminalizing private consensual adult conduct, and Public Law 15-60 enacted August 31, 1979 eliminated the term sodomy while retaining that limited scope.
